passes.title: Complete initial experiment, export and publication implementation
passes.summary: Real SSL/anomaly/frozen-head/four-fold run finished and failed science gate; 72 Python tests and 4 JS tests passed. Three TIFFs and browser-generated full-grid TIFF passed strict Rasterio checks. 7 HTML pages/189 local references checked. Chromium found the laptop download bottom 777.8px below a 768px viewport; image sizing and first-screen layout queued for Pass 2. Browser NSS dependencies recovered from pinned package after apt networking failed.

passes.title: Pathological-input, provenance, reproducibility and first-screen review
passes.summary: Fixed missing-CRS error, zero/invalid masks, hidden NaN multiplication, missing-target NaN gradients, pre-quantization range checks, uint8 mask indexing, empty footprints, unsafe dates, zero-epoch heads, invalid ridge sigma and malformed metadata preservation. Shortened hero, fixed portrait overflow, added portable locked browser libraries and last-good feed cache. Updated executable cold-replication route and restored missing anomaly step in README; original prompt preserved byte-for-byte. 100 Python tests, 5 JS tests, 21 Chromium checks and 189 local references pass. No changed scientific thresholds or promotion of the failed candidate.

passes.title: Cold end-to-end replication and final request reconciliation
passes.summary: Cold source-isolated automatic restore→prepare→six-pass SSL→masked inference→anomaly→four-fold heads/holdout reproduced encoder state, all six metric arms and all three TIFFs exactly. Fresh base install passed 85 non-Torch tests; full environment 100 Python tests and 5 JS tests pass. Added small-phone first-screen check, real direct-download filename/SHA and clipboard test; fixed small-screen wrapping and asynchronous clipboard permissions/fallback. All 26 Chromium checks pass and the actual browser-downloaded TIFF passes independent Rasterio cell/NaN identity. Full original prompt preserved and requirements explicitly distinguish implemented engineering from unmet winning-score/independent-truth goals. PR/deployment follows, recorded separately after execution. Final staging review found and fixed an omitted linked test-source directory; the public allowlist now includes tests without raw data/.git. Final local reference count 192.

scope: Successive implementation checks, not independent scientific experiments. Entries are added only after execution.
